meta.title: IT team for maintaining and evolving your product
meta.description: Add a technical team dedicated to improving, maintaining and growing your website, system or platform on an ongoing basis, without relying on scattered freelancers.
meta.ogTitle: IT team for maintaining and evolving your product | Kodexa

title: Your website or system won't grow on its own.
lead: If nobody is constantly improving it, it stagnates, misses opportunities and ends up falling behind. Add a technical team that thinks about your product every day.
whatsappMessage: Hi Kodexa! I'm interested in adding a technical team for my product. Can we talk?
problemTitle: If your product depends on you today, that's a problem.
problems: You have to solve everything yourself.
You depend on freelancers who disappear.
Everything takes longer than it should.
servicesTitle: You don't need another freelancer. You need a team that thinks about your product.

services.title: Ongoing development
services.text: We don't do one-off tasks: we evolve your product continuously. Every feature has a clear goal: improving conversion, retention or scalability.

services.title: Performance and scalability
services.text: We optimize speed, structure and technical growth: load times, architecture and technical SEO to support real growth.

services.title: Problem solving
services.text: We detect and fix issues before they have an impact: we monitor errors and behavior to act before users are affected.

services.title: Technical decisions
services.text: We take charge of your product's technical direction: we define the stack, architecture and priorities aligned with the business.

servicesNote: We've seen what happens when a system grows without structure, when bugs appear in production or when technical decisions hold the business back. Our job isn't just making it work: it's making it grow without breaking.
priceNote: Price in US dollars (USD). The scope is defined according to your product.
priceTag: You don't pay for tasks. You pay for your product to move forward.
howTitle: A simple process designed to make an impact from the first month.

steps.title: We understand your product
steps.text: We analyze how it works today, where the problems are and what's holding growth back.

steps.title: We spot opportunities
steps.text: We identify concrete improvements that can impact performance, UX or the business.

steps.title: We set priorities
steps.text: We build a clear approach so we don't waste time on things that don't move the needle.

steps.title: We execute and improve
steps.text: We become your technical team and work continuously.

ctaLead: Add a technical team to take care of your product. No initial commitment.
